items.title: Will Earnings Miss Change PulteGroup (PHM) Stock Narrative
items.summary: PulteGroup reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$3,973.85 million and net income of US$475.73 million, with both revenue and earnings for the quarter and first nine months below the prior year. The drop in earnings, combined with pressure from elevated mortgage rates and a slow housing market, highlights how demand and affordability are weighing on PulteGroup's operating performance.
